COLUMBIA GRAIN INTERNATIONAL LLC PRIVACY POLICY
For over 40 years, our customers have trusted Columbia Grain International, LLC (“Columbia Grain” or “Company”) by purchasing our products. We know you care about your privacy too, so we extend that trust relationship to your personal information. We offer this Privacy Policy which explains what information we collect about you; how we collect that information; the purpose for collecting it and how it benefits you; the outside parties we share it with; and your rights, including what you can do regarding your information.
This Privacy Policy describes how we treat personal information on the websites and platforms, in our email messages to you, and in our offline interactions where this Privacy Policy is referenced. This includes the privacy practices of our current Family of Brands. That list can be viewed here. This Policy does not cover, and we are not responsible for, third-party websites, applications or platforms that have a different privacy policy and/or that may be linked from our affiliated websites; linking to them does not imply an endorsement. You should always review the privacy policy of any third-party website or application. Our sites are intended for use only in the United States and are subject to U.S. laws. If you live outside of the United States, you understand and agree that we may transfer your information to the United States.
WE COLLECT AND USE PERSONAL INFORMATION ABOUT YOU.
We collect, receive, and develop several different types of personal information about you depending on the nature of your interactions with us:
Contact Information: If you enter information about yourself, we may collect this information such as your name, email address, social media handles, unique personal identifiers, Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, mailing address, zip code, phone number, or other similar identifiers.
Internet and Network Activity Information: We may collect your IP address when you visit our sites. We may also use tracking tools like cookies and pixels to automatically collect information about how you interact with our websites and online content. This might include device identifiers, the type of browser and operating system you are using, your browsing and search history on our sites, what areas of our sites you visit and for how long, what products or content you view and click on, what site you came from to get to us and what site you go to when you leave us, and your interactions with our digital ads and content on other sites.
Location Information: We may automatically collect information about your precise geolocation when you access the mobile version of our website using GPS and WiFi technology. We also collect information about your general location using your IP address and your zip code if you search online for product retailers near you.
Demographic Information: We may collect demographic information, such as your age or date of birth. We might also collect information about the age ranges of others in your household.
Employment-Related Information: We collect information about your work experience and previous employment, your education history, your resume, the URL to your personal or professional websites, your workplace skill sets and certifications, whether you need a visa to work in the United States, and salary expectations. If you apply for a job, you can choose to also voluntarily provide any of the following information: ethnicity, gender, disability status, and/or veteran status.
WE USE PERSONAL INFORMATION FOR THE PURPOSES DESCRIBED BELOW.
We use information to respond to your requests or questions. We use your information to respond to your questions, complaints, and feedback. If your request relates to product transactions, we may also use your information to identify the particular transaction or product and make any payment adjustments. We also use your information to notify you if you win a sweepstakes or contest.
We use information to communicate with you. We use your information to contact you about career opportunities. We might also use your information to contact you about this Policy (and any updates thereto) or our website Terms.
We use information for security purposes. We use information to protect our company (including our websites) and our customers. We may also need to use your personal information to investigate and remediate fraud or other suspected illegal activity.
We use information for hiring purposes. For example, we use personal information to review your job applications and contact you about employment opportunities. If you choose to voluntarily submit your ethnicity, gender, disability status, and/or veteran status in connection with a job application, we will use that information for statistical tracking purposes, and not for hiring decisions, in accordance with applicable law. We may also use the services of, and share your personal information with, third party service providers to publicize and accept applications for available career and intern positions with the Company.
We use information to verify requests made pursuant to this Policy. We will use certain pieces of information to verify your identity if you make requests pursuant to this Policy. The verification steps and the pieces of information that we request may vary depending on the sensitivity and nature of your request.
We use information as otherwise permitted or required by law or as we may notify you.
WE COLLECT PERSONAL INFORMATION ABOUT YOU FROM VARIOUS SOURCES, DIRECTLY AND INDIRECTLY.
We collect information directly from you via your devices. For example, we may collect information when you register an account, buy or return a product, sign up for an e-newsletter, enter a contest, submit or post a recipe or other content, or otherwise contact us. We don’t use tracking tools like browser cookies, beacons, or pixels, to automatically collect information about you. We collect only the information you choose to share with us when you interact with our websites, our ads, and our emails that we send to you.
We get information from suppliers we hire to work on our behalf. For example, suppliers that host or maintain our websites and send promotional emails for us may give us information. Our employment and recruiting partners also give us information.
We get information about you from other parties. We work with business and marketing partners and social media platforms that give us information about you that you share directly with them. We may also receive information from a job network or social network if you choose to import your information from those platforms when applying for a job with us. We also use features that let your friends give us your information.
We may combine information about you in a variety of ways. We may combine information collected offline, such as information collected about you when you interact with our call center, with information collected online. We may combine information collected across devices, such as computers and mobile devices. These actions allow us to understand your buying preferences more holistically. We also may combine your information with other buyers’ information to understand preferences and trends within your peer group over time.
To determine the appropriate retention period for information before we securely destroy it, we consider the amount, nature, and sensitivity of the information, the potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure of your information, the purposes for which we process your information and whether we can achieve those purposes through other means, and the applicable legal requirements. In some circumstances we may anonymize your personal information so that it can no longer be associated with you, in which case we may use such information without further notice to you.
WE SHARE INFORMATION WITH OTHER PARTIES.
We may share information within Columbia Grain International LLC and its partners and/or subsidiaries.
We may share information with suppliers/partners that perform services on our behalf for our own business and operational purposes. We may share information with suppliers/partners that send emails for us, run our websites and contests, process payments, provide advertising or marketing services, track advertising impressions, provide analytics services, investigate and prevent data incidents, audit our business and financial statements, vet job applicants, provide legal advice, place our advertisements on other platforms, and fulfill and ship orders.
We may share your information with business partners and marketing companies. We may also share personal information with other parties, including those that run social media platforms, that help us with marketing. This may include social media platforms, advertising networks, and ad tech companies.
We will share information in order to comply with the law or to protect ourselves. For example, we will share information as required to respond to a court order or subpoena. We may share information if a government agency or investigatory body requests it. We might share information when we are investigating potential fraud, including fraud we think has happened during a contest or promotion. Or we may share your information if you are the winner of a contest or promotion with anyone who requests a winner’s list.
We may share information with any successor to Company, or all or part of our business. For example, if part of our business is sold, we may give our customer database to the buyer of the business as part of that transaction.
YOU HAVE CHOICES AND RIGHTS REGARDING OUR USE OF YOUR INFORMATION.
You can opt-out of receiving our marketing emails. To stop receiving our promotional emails, follow the instructions in any promotional message you get from us. Some of our sites allow you to modify your preferences to opt-out. Even if you opt-out of getting marketing messages, we will still send you messages if you transact directly with us.
You can control certain cookies and tracking tools. You can control tools on your mobile devices. For example, you can turn off the GPS locator on your phone.
YOUR CALIFORNIA PRIVACY RIGHTS.
If you are a California resident, you can make the following requests with respect to your personal information:
Access – You can request that we disclose to you the following: (i) the categories of personal information that we have collected about you; (ii) the categories of sources from which we have collected personal information about you; (iii) the business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling your personal information; (iv) the categories of personal information that we have sold about you and the categories of outside parties to whom the personal information was sold; (v) the categories of personal information that we have disclosed about you for our business purposes and the categories of vendors to whom the personal information was disclosed; and (vi) the specific pieces of personal information that we have collected about you over the past 12 months.
Deletion – You can request that we delete the personal information that we maintain about you, subject to certain exceptions.
